profiles.finding: Handy pp. 288–290 confirms physical departure February 26, 1864. No admission date identified. Distinct military officers named Gibson excluded.
Handy pp. 288–290 records February 26 release order and oath. Only Gibson departed that day; no individual departure or admission date established. Existing fields preserved.
Handy p. 25 places Wier already confined July 27, 1863, not admitted that day. Page 104 confirms September 2 departure with Richards after oath. No admission established.
